relationships.subject: Maresin 1
relationships.evidence_quote: In TMJ-related trigeminal nociceptors, MaR1 potently inhibits capsaicin-induced TRPV1 channel currents and neuronal activity.

relationships.subject: Maresin 1
relationships.evidence_quote: MaR1 binding to GPR37L1 on astrocytes specifically enhances the activity and expression of the glutamate transporter GLT-1 (EAAT2)

relationships.subject: Maresin 1
relationships.evidence_quote: In the zymosan-induced mouse vulvodynia model, topical application of MaR1 increases the mechanical sensitivity threshold (ie, relieves pain) and reduces the level of prostaglandin E2.

relationships.subject: Maresin 1
relationships.evidence_quote: Quantitative immunofluorescence revealed that MaR1 treatment significantly decreased Iba-1 (microglia) and GFAP (astrocyte) signal intensities in the spinal dorsal horn

key_findings: Review: MaR1 relieves pain across preclinical models via glial deactivation (GPR37L1), TRPV1 inhibition (RORA), and nerve regeneration; sex-dependent efficacy and instability limit translation.
